**Press Enter twice to send.** When the send guard holds a message (coordinates, a base name, or every message with "ask before sending" on), the chat box now stays open with your message still in it. Press Enter again and it goes: no more opening chat and clicking [Send]. Change anything in it and it's checked again. [Send anyway] and [Edit] still work as before.

**The main screen, polished like the Baritone screen.**
- **Pictures on the section tabs** (Players, Groups, Chat, Intel, Activity, Server, Baritone, Settings), when the window has room.
- **Keys:** / goes to the search box, 1 to 8 open the sections, the arrow keys move along the player cards and Enter opens the picked one. ↓ or Enter from the search box goes straight into the results.
- **Tips:** rest the mouse on a tab, a list counter, the All / Near / Online / Offline switch, the search box or the ☀ / ☾ button and it says what it's for (tabs show their key).
- **Safer:** Clear on the disconnect history asks "Sure?" first.
